story.title: How I use LLMs to learn complex topics

draft:
I've been using Large Language Models to accelerate my learning of complex topics. 
I find that LLMs help me identify key concepts and relationships. 
Key benefits include:
* Faster grasping of new ideas
* Improved retention of complex information
What role do you think LLMs will play in the future of learning?
